findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_ingredient, search_ingredients, check_ingredient_list, search_products, get_product, get_coupons, search_recalls, official_sources · Private data: about, lookup_ingredient, search_ingredients, check_ingredient_list, search_products, get_product, get_coupons, find_deals, recent_updates, search_recalls, official_sources, ask_kbeauty_verified · Public sink: get_coupons.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_ingredient, search_ingredients, check_ingredient_list, search_products, get_product, get_coupons, search_recalls, official_sources · Private data: about, lookup_ingredient, search_ingredients, check_ingredient_list, search_products, get_product, get_coupons, find_deals, recent_updates, search_recalls, official_sources, ask_kbeauty_verified · Public sink: get_coupons

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_product" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
